heard: Defenders taunted Alexander that he needed winged soldiers to take their mountain. Most thought the Sogdian rock was impregnable in 327 B.C. Alexander promised a fortune to 300 volunteers to climb it. They hammered iron tent pegs into ice through the night. Thirty men fell into deep snow and were never found. At dawn, survivors waved linen flags from the summit. The fortress surrendered to soldiers who did did not need wings.
